_comment: Community-contributed known-issue signatures. When a set of readings matches a signature, FlipDoctor can attach a more specific explanation. This is a Tier 3 feature; the format is intentionally simple so owners can contribute via PR.

signatures.note: IR TX works but RX sees nothing. Commonly dust/obstruction over the receive window, or testing in bright IR-heavy light. Clean the window and retry in a dim room before assuming hardware failure.
Card detected but read/write mismatches often mean dirty/oxidized contacts or a failing card. Try reseating or a different microSD card before concluding the slot is faulty.
Voltage nominal but reduced health is normal battery aging. Expect shorter runtime; not a fault.
